title: CLI sibling-daemon delegation revocation forwarding and susi harness run --delegation DelegationScope admission
goal: Close the two Mandate 73 CLI/daemon delegation gaps in `docs/recursive-delegation.md`: (1) forward `susi os capabilities revoke <id>` across live sibling Susi processes on `<cache>/bus/<pid>/` (`daemon.harness` `revoke_delegation`) while preserving instant offline local revocation, reporting `local_revoked`, `daemon_contacted`, `daemon_revoked`, and `cancelled_runs`; and (2) add `--delegation <JSON|@file>` to standalone `susi harness run` (`crates/susi-cli-defs/src/harness.rs`, `src/cli/harness_cli.rs`), opening a `susi_core::delegation::DelegationScope` (`susi-harness:harness.cli.run` requiring `harness:run`), clamping `--timeout` to the envelope's remaining deadline, reserving `--budget-usd` in micro-USD, charging actual ledger spend, and refunding unspent micro-USD on drop.
limitations: `susi os capabilities revoke <id>` reaches live sibling Susi processes registered on `<cache>/bus/<pid>/` (such as the daemon), not standalone processes without a registered plane-bus listener.
GEMI worker delegation and GAWD swarm hand-offs remain future `DelegationScope` slices; Windows x86_64 release qualification remains owed on a native Windows host.
